objectives: The aim is to provide our first-year students an opportunity to broaden their vision to research areas of nature science and bioengineering that could be potentially incorporated into their neuroscience research.
content:
Each group will choose 3-4 labs for lecture/visit (like one hour lecture and two hour experiment demonstration).
Each lab/PI will provide a 3-hour lecture/open lab visit to the group of students.
